summary.text: Jennifer Boysko is a Democratic member of the Senate of Virginia representing District 38.
The Senate biography lists Jennifer Boysko's service in the House of Delegates from 2016 to 2019 and in the Senate since 2019.

paragraphs.text: According to the Senate biography, Jennifer Boysko was born in Pine Bluff, Arkansas, on November 16, 1966.
Jennifer Boysko studied at Hollins University (B.A.).
Jennifer Boysko's listed occupation is community organizer.

Jennifer Boysko's listed memberships and affiliations include chair of the Broadband Advisory Council and Senate representative for the Northern Virginia Transportation Authority, the Northern Virginia Growing Needs of Public Transit Joint Subcommittee, and the Regional Transportation Planning Board.
The biography lists Glenn J. Boysko as Jennifer Boysko's spouse.
The Senate page lists Jennifer Boysko's committee assignments as Commerce and Labor, Courts of Justice, Education and Health, Finance and Appropriations, and Transportation.
